DECLARE

/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SURT_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز المستخدم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SURT_TRMGRP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز المجموعة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SURT_SU_FK2') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع المستخدم,وظيفته,تصنيفه' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SURT_BKM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رقم الرخصة,نوع الرخصة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SRER_SURT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'Surt Port Cd,Surt Request Seq,Surt Request Date' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SRER_ROL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الصلاحية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'Sc Request Roles','طلبات المستخدمين' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'Sc Request Roles','طلبات المستخدمين' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SRUG_USRGRP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز مجموعة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SRUG_SURT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رقم مسلسل الطلب,تاريخ الطلب,رمز الجمرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'مجموعات طلبات التحويل','طلبات المستخدمين' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'مجموعات طلبات التحويل','طلبات المستخدمين' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SURT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الجمرك,مسلسل الطلب,تاريخه' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BKM_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BKM_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('رقم السجل المدني لايمكن أن يتكرر لمخلص آخر', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'TRMGRP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الجمرك,رمز المجموعة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SRER_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'Surt Port Cd,Surt Request Seq,Surt Reque' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'ROL_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الصلاحية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SRUG_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'GROUP_ID,PORT_CD,REQUEST_SEQ,REQUEST_DAT' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'USRGRP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', '' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'USRGRP_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('تم ادخال مجموعة بنفس الاسم الانجليزى من قبل', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES */
PROCEDURE CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES(
 P_CANVAS_LIST IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* List of displayed canvases */
 ,P_CURRENT_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2 /* Current canvas */
 ,P_BASE_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Base canvas */
/* Display the current canvas plus any others in the canvas list */
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255); /* List of displayed canvases */
 canvas_to_raise VARCHAR2(255); /* Canvas to raise to the top */
BEGIN
 IF ( P_CURRENT_CANVAS = P_BASE_CANVAS) THEN
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 ELSE
 P_CANVAS_LIST := replace(P_CANVAS_LIST, P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',');
 IF ( get_view_property(P_BASE_CANVAS, VISIBLE) = 'FALSE') THEN
 canvas_list := P_CANVAS_LIST;
 WHILE (canvas_list IS NOT NULL) LOOP
 canvas_to_raise := substr(canvas_list, 1, instr(canvas_list, ','));
 canvas_list := replace(canvas_list, canvas_to_raise);
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(rtrim(canvas_to_raise, ','));
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CANVAS_LIST || P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 END IF;
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(P_CURRENT_CANVAS);
END;

PROCEDURE UPDATE_REQUEST(P_MASTER_DETIL NUMBER) IS
BEGIN
IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('REQUEST_STAGE',DATABASE_VALUE) = :REQUEST_STAGE AND :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_STAGE NOT IN (1,3,5,7) THEN
 IF P_MASTER_DETIL = 1 THEN --FOR MASTER
 IF :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE = 2 AND :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD = 1 AND :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID = 39 THEN
 IF :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_STAGE = 4 THEN
 :REQUEST_STAGE := 5;
 ELSIF :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_STAGE = 6 THEN
 :REQUEST_STAGE := 7;
 END IF;

 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE = 2 AND :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD = 1 AND :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID = 8 THEN
 IF :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_STAGE = 4 THEN
 :REQUEST_STAGE := 5;
 ELSIF :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_STAGE = 6 THEN
 :REQUEST_STAGE := 7;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE = :USR_TYPE_CD AND :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD = :CLASS_CD AND ( :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID = 1 OR (:PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD = 55 AND :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID = 14 ) ) THEN
 :REQUEST_STAGE := 3;
 END IF;
 BEGIN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(2,30,2,:SC_REQUEST.PORT_CD||'!'||:SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_SEQ||'!'||:SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_DATE) THEN
 RAISE FORM_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END;
 ELSE--FOR DETAILED
 IF :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE = 2 AND :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD = 1 AND :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID = 39 THEN -- تعديل من المساعد
 IF :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_STAGE = 4 THEN
 :REQUEST_STAGE := 5;
 UPDATE SC_USER_REQUESTS
 SET REQUEST_STAGE = 5
 WHERE PORT_CD = :SC_REQUEST.PORT_CD
 AND REQUEST_SEQ = :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_SEQ
 AND REQUEST_DATE = :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_DATE
 ;
 ELSIF :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_STAGE = 6 THEN
 :REQUEST_STAGE := 7;
 UPDATE SC_USER_REQUESTS
 SET REQUEST_STAGE = 7
 WHERE PORT_CD = :SC_REQUEST.PORT_CD
 AND REQUEST_SEQ = :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_SEQ
 AND REQUEST_DATE = :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_DATE

ProgramUnit.Name: CONVERT_REQUEST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE convert_request(P_TO NUMBER) IS

 V_MANAGER NUMBER;
/*
P_TO = 2 تحويل الطلب لرئيس القسم
P_TO = 3 تحويل الطلب لمساعد مدير عام الجمرك
P_TO = 4 تحويل الطلب لمدير عام الجمرك
P_TO = 5 تحويل الطلب لرئيس الحاسب مع الموافقة
P_TO = 6 تحويل الطلب لرئيس الحاسب مع الرفض
*/

 PROCEDURE INSERT_TRANSFEER IS
 V_MAX NUMBER;
 BEGIN

 SELECT NVL(MAX(TRANSFER_SEQ),0)+1 INTO V_MAX
 FROM SC_REQUEST_TRANSFERS
 ;
 INSERT INTO SC_REQUEST_TRANSFERS(TRANSFER_SEQ,USER_ID,PORT_CD,REQUEST_SEQ,REQUEST_DATE)
 VALUES (V_MAX,:GLOBAL.TRANSF_TO_USER ,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,:SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_SEQ,:SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_DATE)
 ;
 END;


BEGIN
 IF P_TO = 2 THEN

 IF :SC_REQUEST.USR_TYPE_CD = 2 AND :SC_REQUEST.CLASS_CD = 55 THEN
 V_MANAGER := 14;
 ELSE
 V_MANAGER := 1;
 END IF;
 LOV_USER_TRANSFEER(:SC_REQUEST.USR_TYPE_CD,:SC_REQUEST.CLASS_CD,V_MANAGER );

 ELSIF P_TO = 4 THEN
 LOV_USER_TRANSFEER(2,1,39);
 ELSIF P_TO = 6 THEN
 LOV_USER_TRANSFEER(2,1,8);
 ELSIF P_TO = 8 THEN
 LOV_USER_TRANSFEER(2,4,1);
 END IF;

 IF :GLOBAL.TRANSF_TO_USER IS NOT NULL THEN
 INSERT_TRANSFEER;
 :REQUEST_STAGE := P_TO;
 :GLOBAL.TRANSF_TO_USER :=NULL;
 IF :REQUEST_STATUS = 1 THEN
 :REQUEST_STATUS := 2;
 ELSIF :REQUEST_STATUS = 2 AND P_TO = 8 THEN
 :REQUEST_STATUS := 3;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT(' يجب اختيار الموظف المحول له من القائمة حتى تتم عملية التحويل.. ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;


END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADJ_FUNS IS
 V_USR_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_JOB_ID NUMBER;
 V_CLASS_CD NUMBER;
 V_ASSIST NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_ASSIST FROM SC_USERS
 WHERE USR_TYPE_CD = 2
 AND CLASS_CD = 1
 AND JOB_ID = 39
 AND USR_LOCKED = 0
 AND
 (
 SUBSTR(SC_USERS.USER_ID ,1,2) = (SELECT VAR_VALUE FROM SC_PORT_SETTING WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = 999 AND VAR_NAME = 'USER_PRIFEX' AND PORT_CD=:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD)
 OR
 SUBSTR(SC_USERS.USER_ID ,1,1) = (SELECT VAR_VALUE FROM SC_PORT_SETTING WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = 999 AND VAR_NAME = 'USER_PRIFEX' AND PORT_CD=:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD)
 )
 ;

 V_USR_TYPE_CD := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('USR_TYPE_CD',DATABASE_VALUE);
 V_JOB_ID := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('JOB_ID',DATABASE_VALUE);
 V_CLASS_CD := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('CLASS_CD',DATABASE_VALUE);

IF :REQUEST_STATUS IN (4,6) THEN-- اذا كان الطلب ملغي او مرفوض يحق لموظفي ادارة خدمات المستفيدين اعادة حالة الطلب الى مبدئي
 TMPLT.DISABLE_ALL_FUNS;
 IF :REQUEST_STATUS IN(4,6) AND (:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID LIKE 'S%' OR :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID ='APPDEV04') THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_INITIALLY');
 END IF;

 ELSE
 TMPLT.DISABLE_ALL_FUNS;
 IF :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :REQUEST_STAGE = 1 THEN
 IF (:PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE = 2 AND :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD = 4 AND :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID IN(1,2,11)) THEN
 IF V_USR_TYPE_CD = 3 OR V_JOB_ID = 1 THEN
 --TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_TRNS2');--مساعد مدير الجمرك
 IF NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('NO_MANAGER_ASSIST',2),0)= 1 AND V_ASSIST = 0 THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_TRNS3');
 ELSE
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_TRNS2');--مساعد مدير الجمرك
 END IF;
 ELSIF V_JOB_ID IN(39,8) THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_TRNS3');
 ELSE
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_TRNS1');--رئيس القسم
 END IF;

 IF :REQUEST_TYPE= 1 THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_NEW_USER');
 END IF;

 END IF;

 ELSIF :REQUEST_STAGE IN(2,3) THEN
 IF (:PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE = V_USR_TYPE_CD AND( (:PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD = V_CLASS_CD AND :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID = 1 ) OR (:PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD = 55 AND :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID = 14 AND V_CLASS_CD = 55)) ) THEN
 --TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_TRNS2');
 IF NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('NO_MANAGER_ASSIST',2),0)= 1 AND V_ASSIST = 0 THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_TRNS3');
 ELSE
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_TRNS2');--مساعد مدير الجمرك
 END IF;
 IF :REQUEST_TYPE = 1 AND :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_NEW_USER');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :REQUEST_STAGE IN(4,5) THEN
 IF (:PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE = 2 AND :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD = 1 AND :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID IN(8,39)) THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_TRNS3');
 IF :REQUEST_TYPE = 1 AND :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_NEW_USER');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :REQUEST_STAGE IN(6,7) THEN
 IF (:PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE = 2 AND :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD = 1 AND :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID IN(8,39) ) THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_TRNS4');
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_TRNS5');
 IF :REQUEST_TYPE = 1 AND :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_NEW_USER');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :REQUEST_STAGE = 8 AND :REQUEST_STATUS = 3 THEN -- الطلب معتمد ومحول الى رئيس الحاسب الالي
 IF :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE = 2 AND :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD = 4 AND :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID = 1 AND :REQUEST_TYPE NOT IN (1,2,9,12,13) THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_EXEC');
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID LIKE 'S%' THEN
 IF :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_TYPE IN (1,2,9,12,13) THEN -- هذه الانواع من الطلبات تقوم ادارة خدمات المستفيدين بتنفيذها فقط

TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_EXEC');
 END IF;
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_TRNS5');--صلاحية رفض الطلب
 IF :REQUEST_TYPE= 1 THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_NEW_USER');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF (:PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE = 2 AND :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD = 4 AND :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID IN(1,2) AND :REQUEST_TYPE = 1 ) THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('SC1656_NEW_USER');
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;

IF :REQUEST_STATUS = 2 THEN-- اذا كان الطلب غير ملغي او مرفوض او معتمد يحق لمدير ادارة الحاسب الالي اعادة حالة الطلب الى مبدئي
 IF ((:PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE = 2 AND :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD = 4 AND :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID = 1) OR :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID ='APPDEV04') THEN

END IF;

PROCEDURE ADD_REMOVE_ROLES(P_TYPE NUMBER) IS

 CURSOR REQ_ROLE IS
 SELECT ROLE_ID,UER_ACTIVE
 FROM SC_REQUEST_ROLES
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND REQUEST_SEQ = :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_SEQ
 AND REQUEST_DATE = :SC_REQUEST.REQUEST_DATE
 AND ROLE_TYPE = P_TYPE
 ;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF P_TYPE = 1 AND :REQUEST_TYPE = 2 THEN -- ADD ROLES
 FOR I IN REQ_ROLE LOOP
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM SC_USER_EXCLUDED_ROLES
 WHERE USER_ID = :SC_REQUEST.USER_ID
 AND PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND ROLE_ID = I.ROLE_ID
 ;
 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 DELETE FROM SC_USER_EXCLUDED_ROLES
 WHERE USER_ID = :SC_REQUEST.USER_ID
 AND PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND ROLE_ID = I.ROLE_ID
 ;
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES
 WHERE USER_ID = :SC_REQUEST.USER_ID
 AND PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND ROLE_ID = I.ROLE_ID
 ;
 IF V_COUNT = 0 THEN
 INSERT INTO SC_USER_ROLES (PORT_CD,USER_ID,UR_ACTIVE,CREATED_BY,CREATED_DATE,MODIFIED_BY,MODIFIED_DATE,ROLE_ID)
 VALUES (:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,:SC_REQUEST.USER_ID,I.UER_ACTIVE,'$$USER$$',SYSDATE,'$$USER$$',SYSDATE,I.ROLE_ID )
 ;
 END IF;
 ELSE

 INSERT INTO SC_USER_ROLES (PORT_CD,USER_ID,UR_ACTIVE,CREATED_BY,CREATED_DATE,MODIFIED_BY,MODIFIED_DATE,ROLE_ID)
 VALUES (:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,:SC_REQUEST.USER_ID,I.UER_ACTIVE,'$$USER$$',SYSDATE,'$$USER$$',SYSDATE,I.ROLE_ID )
 ;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 ELSIF P_TYPE = 2 AND :REQUEST_TYPE = 5 THEN -- REMOVE ROLES
 FOR I IN REQ_ROLE LOOP
 INSERT INTO SC_USER_EXCLUDED_ROLES (PORT_CD,USER_ID,UER_ACTIVE,ROLE_ID)
 VALUES (:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,:SC_REQUEST.USER_ID,I.UER_ACTIVE,I.ROLE_ID )
 ;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-HELP

 IF (:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE IS NULL) THEN

 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HPATH || '';

 0 /* IN : Help Context Id */

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGLT$TAB_BLOCK_MANAGEMENT */
/* Switch tab management code on/off */
DECLARE
 current_canvas VARCHAR2(61) := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ITEM_CANVAS);
 base_canvas VARCHAR2(61);
BEGIN
 CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES(current_canvas, base_canvas);
 IF( base_canvas IN ( 'CG$PAGE_1' ) ) THEN
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := TRUE;
 ELSE
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := FALSE;
 END IF;
END;
/* CGLY$MANAGE_CANVASES */
/* Call procedure to ensure correct canvases are visible */
BEGIN
 CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT;
END;


/* CGLT$TAB_NEW_BLOCK */
/* Show canvases for this block */
BEGIN
 IF CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE = TRUE THEN
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.CGLT$NEW_BLOCK;
 END IF;
END;

/* CGBS$WHEN_NEW_BLOCK_INSTANCE */
/* ensure the current canvas is correctly coordinated */
BEGIN
 CGBS$.NEW_BLOCK( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE);
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-CLEAR-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$ON_CLEAR_DETAILS */
/* clear all detail blocks for the given master block */
BEGIN
 IF (FORM_FAILURE AND :SYSTEM.COORDINATION_OPERATION IN ('MOUSE', 'DUPLICATE_RECORD')) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF (:SYSTEM.MASTER_BLOCK = :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK) THEN
 CGBS$.CLEAR_MASTER_DETAIL( :SYSTEM.MASTER_BLOCK, :SYSTEM.COORDINATION_OPERATION );
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$ON_POPULATE_DETAILS */
/* query all detail blocks for the given master block */
BEGIN
 CGBS$.QUERY_DETAILS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CQUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$KEY_CQUERY_FRM */
/* Check if query is allowed to avoid unnecessary coordination */
BEGIN
 IF (get_block_property( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK, QUERY_ALLOWED) = 'FALSE') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(37, 'Query not allowed in this block'), 'E', 'OFG', 37);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 CGBS$.DO_KEYQRY( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK, 'COUNT_QUERY', :SYSTEM.MODE);
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$KEY_CLRREC */
/* Avoid clearing details if current row is new and invalid */
BEGIN
 IF ( CGBS2$.IS_RECORD_DIRTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK) ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF (:SYSTEM.BLOCK_STATUS = 'CHANGED' OR CGBS2$.IS_COMMIT_NEEDED( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK ) ) THEN
 CGBS2$.DO_COMMIT_DIALOGUE;
 END IF;
 clear_record;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NXTKEY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$DISABLE_NXTKEY */
/* Disable KEY-NXTKEY for the whole form */
BEGIN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(30, 'Key not valid in this context'), 'E', 'OFG', 30);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-MENU
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE_QUERY_MODE */
/* This changes the mode of block synchronization so that if it is */
/* currently ON, then it is changed to OFF, and vice-versa. */
/* It also queries the dependent blocks as appropriate for the */
/* new mode. */
BEGIN
 CGBS$TOGGLE( :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRFRM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGGN$KEY_CLRFRM */
/* Perform the key's standard functionality */
BEGIN
 clear_form;
 IF :SYSTEM.FORM_STATUS = 'CHANGED' THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

 CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE;

 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
END;

 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.CGLT$TAB_CHANGED;
